Model interaction journey

Fresh isolated worker, real HTTP, durable checkpoints and model adapters. A deterministic local executable replaces the provider; token counters are synthetic. No paid provider, account quota or billed cost was exercised. Screenshots include full-page captures and compact checkpoint crops. Software keyboard was not tested.

Verified: pending question and unsent answer survive restart and access expiry; explicit answer and fenced stop; revised context continuation preserves earlier evidence; normalized events and consumption coverage. No document overflow at the captured 1440, 390 and 320 pixel widths; no browser page errors.
